newsitem.title: USA: Binks reorganizes business, changes name.
newsitem.headline: Binks reorganizes business, changes name.

text.p: Binks Manufacturing Co, a spray finishing and coating equipment manufacturer, said Tuesday it is reorganizing its global operations and internal management structure.
As part of the reorganization, Binks Manufacturing will change its name to Binks-Sames Corp to reflect the international strength of its Sames SA subsidiary, based in France, the company said.

The company will consolidate the manufacturing and sales operations of Binks, Sames and its other subsidiaries into three primary markets -- North America, Europe and the Pacific Rim. Binks will also categorize products into three areas -- automotive, standard and engineering.
Binks currently operates worldwide through 11 foreign subsidiaries.
A vice president will lead each of the three geographic areas and each of the three product groups.

"In the coming months and years, we expect that the financial status of Binks-Sames will continue to improve dramatically," John Schornack, chairman, said in a statement. "These changes position Binks for growth and provide the foundation of a larger plan for achieving higher levels of sales and profitability as well as lower levels of debt from increased cash flow."
The company said it will enhance customer services and focus on high technology. It said it has gained market share in the high-technology segments of the industry.

Terence Roche, executive vice president, will lead a "global strategy board" which will meet quarterly to set strategies for product development. The board, comprised of vice presidents of various areas, will report to the chief executive and the board of directors, Binks said.
The company's automotive original equipment manufacturer division is already organized on a worldwide basis, Binks said.
"(I)ts successes are worth emulating," said Doran Unschuld, president and chief executive of Binks.
